tools.description: Tools used in this education. Each entry is a URI reference to a tool item record owned by the same DID. Consumers ignore entries that do not resolve.

degree.description: Degree name (e.g., 'Bachelor of Science', 'Master of Arts').

labels.description: Self-label values for this education record.

skills.description: Skills gained or used in this education. Each entry is a URI reference to an id.sifa.profile.skill record owned by the same DID.

endedAt.description: End date (graduation or expected graduation) in YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit if currently enrolled.

agentRef.description: The educational institution, as a single nested reference mirroring the flat institution / institutionDid / entityRef fields. Additive dual-write: the flat fields remain the source of truth for existing consumers.

eqfLevel.description: Level of the qualification on the European Qualifications Framework (EQF), 1 to 8. 6 is bachelor level, 7 is master level, 8 is doctoral level. Omit when unknown. The free-text degree stays the display name.

location.description: Institution location. Sifa enforces ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes at the app layer.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

entityRef.description: Portable, app-neutral identifier for the educational institution the user selected from a resolver dropdown: a Wikidata Q-ID URI (http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q...), a ROR URI, or an LEI URI. Enables deterministic resolution to a canonical entity even before the institution claims an ATproto account. Absent for free-text entries.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the user's primary education entry, surfaced in profile Highlights. Any entry may be primary.

startedAt.description: Start date in YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format.

description.description: Additional description or notes about the education.

institutionDid.description: DID of the institution's ATproto account, if one exists.

main.description: Record representing a single education credential.
main.x-skos:note: One record maps to two schema.org assertions: alumniOf for the institution and hasCredential for the degree.

description: An education entry in the user's professional profile.
